claim_summary: At vertex time scaled by m^(2/3), the common-key triangle birth process in the uniform two-key random intersection graph converges to a key-marked Poisson process of intensity 4t^2 dt du, with one-time triangle-count Poisson total-variation error O_b(m^(-1/3)) on every bounded rescaled horizon.

integrity.evidence: Self-contained analytic proof and standalone deterministic/exact finite checks; no external certification

scientific_limitations: Exactly two distinct keys per vertex; no growing rescaled horizon result
Finite-time total variation applies to single-time triangle counts, not the entire path law
The first triangle limiting probability uses an established older zero-one threshold rather than claiming the threshold as new
Independent mathematical validation and exhaustive historical priority certification are not performed
title: Marked Poisson triangle births in two-key random intersection graphs
